about: FLAMINGO P_dE = P_hE/b(k) and P_EE (with errors) at the core snapshots, and the joint fits of fits/hmc_rb_fit.py at k_max = 0.52 h/Mpc (fitted to 0.05 <= k <= 0.52 at all nine snapshots at once): 1p one population, A1 ((1+z)/1.62)^eta1; 1pB one population, A1 b_g/1.5; rbB red and blue centrals each with amplitude times its own bias; rbF21 red and blue centrals with constant amplitudes (Fortuna et al. 2021 Eqs. 3-4, no red-blue II cross term). chi2_snap: chi2 of each model at each snapshot over its 3 x n_k fitted points.
